title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Thu 26 Nov
summary: A flat day (forecast moderate). Thermals stayed flat all day. The upslope ran from about 11:00 to about 17:35. A low day for November: the base stayed down near 3,100 ft (normal 4,500–5,500 ft). Yesterday evening, the page called it may be high, about 5,200 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 3,100 ft by the Kekoa camera, 2,100 ft lower than yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 5,200 ft, off by 2,100 ft. Most of the day the shear line was north of Makawao. Data gaps: no readings all day from 3 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula, Upper Kahikinui); the Mesonet could not be reached on 52 of 54 updates.
